title: Storybook
description: A children's picture book: a cover, then one page per beat — each page one big emoji scene built from a hero emoji and its friends, over one short, friendly sentence. The words get simpler and warmer; the facts stay exactly as the article gives them.

hero.description: The cover's hero emoji: the story's main character or thing, drawn very big.

friends.description: Optional: up to four more emoji placed around the hero to compose the scene — the sky, the sea, the weather, the hero's friends. Decoration only; they carry no fact.

opening.description: The cover line, short and storybook-warm: who the story is about and where it happens, as the article gives them. Start it like a story ('Once upon a time, …').

pages.description: The story in order, one page per beat. If a beat needs two sentences, give it two pages instead of a longer page.

hero.description: This page's hero emoji, drawn very big: the thing this beat is about.

friends.description: Optional: up to four more emoji placed around the hero to compose the scene — the sky, the sea, the weather, the hero's friends. Decoration only; they carry no fact.

text.description: ONE short, friendly sentence a child could follow, carrying one fact from the article, numbers copied exactly: "For 32 years, Petal splish-splashed across the river."

closing.description: Optional: the last page's line, what the story means or what happens next, only as the article gives it. The template adds 'And so' in front of it, so start with a small letter.
